description: Utility class providing static methods for safe and convenient mathematical operations on Numbers, BigDecimals, and Money objects, including null handling, comparisons, arithmetic, normalization, and percentage calculations.

classes.name: MathUtil
classes.description: Final utility class with static methods for mathematical operations and null-safe handling of numeric types and Money objects.
